To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the nation-state is a political entity that is based on a shared sense of belonging, and that the idea of self-reliance in India is a complex one that is shaped by a variety of factors, including historical, political, and cultural influences.
the nation-state has been a powerful and pervasive idea in the history of the twentieth century.
The pandemic has led us to reflect on what it means for us to be self reliant.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following questions: What is the relationship between the self and the nation in the context of self reliance?
the question of how the self of the nation is constituted through the practices of everyday life and how these practices are implicated in the claims of self reliance made by the nation.
the following questions: (i) How does the nation-state define the self?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the self of the nation is the national self.
the idea of self reliant India as a nation is a fallacy, a myth.
the nation is a self of the nation and the nation is not a national self.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the idea of self of a nation is an idea that is not only a product of a specific history of the nation, but also one that is a product of a certain idea of the nation.
while the self of the nation is the idea of the self which is a product of the nation, the idea of national-self is the self which produces the nation.
while self reliance of the nation is a political project, the national self is the outcome of this political project.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the idea of self reliance is not a new one, it has been in existence in different forms since the time of colonialism.
self reliance is a political project and the claims of self reliance by the nation state are a political strategy.

while the idea of self of a nation may lead to a sense of self reliance in terms of the nation’s ability to meet its own needs, the idea of the national self may lead to a more sustainable sense of self reliance that does not depend on the nation’s ability alone but also depends on the ability of others.
